## Winter '27 Agentforce — FIRMED UP since 2026-08-21

- **BOTH marketing agents now named** (last scan had only the first):
  1. **Marketing Goals Agent** — and the autonomy model is now documented and is STRONGER than last
     scan's "translates objectives into strategies": users "define a goal, **budget**, and eligible
     audience," the agent proposes a strategy for review and approval, and once activated it
     "**operates autonomously within those guardrails, continuously optimizing** activities and
     decisions toward the desired outcome."
     => A STANDING GRANT, NOT A TASK. One human approval authorizes ongoing spend and targeting
        decisions with no per-decision review.
     => The **budget is a governance object** — same pattern as the AgentCore session budget
        (reported 2026-08-21): the human-set ceiling is the only real bound on autonomous commercial
        action. Large/absent budget = a finding.
     => The **eligible audience is a standing data-scope grant** over prospect + campaign data.
     => Record the ACTIVATION EVENT AND ITS APPROVER as the authorization for everything after.
  2. **Agentforce Content Agent** — creates campaign content at scale while maintaining brand
     consistency.                                     [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/AISPM]
- **Agentforce observability** — refined agent analytics and **custom scorers**, some in Beta.
- Also listed: agent interoperability, improved Agentforce Voice, multilingual conversations,
  improved agent management, a new **Agentforce Builder** version.
- **Agentforce Lead Nurturing -> Agentforce Engagement** rename (reported 2026-08-21). DETECTION
  HAZARD: match on stable identifiers, never display names.
- AI **call-coaching agent** for Agentforce for Sales, auto-evaluates recorded calls
  (reported 2026-08-21) — reads RECORDED CUSTOMER CALLS.

## NOT a Winter '27 item — do not re-attribute
"Unlock Agent Interoperability with MCP for Agentforce" carries a release date of the **week of
2026-05-18**. Aggregator articles conflate releases; always check the per-feature date.
